translations.en: Should you attack without a word, or try talking?
Fight
Explain why you came
There was no time to waste here.
You drew your weapon without another word.
Hmph. You barbarian...
You cut the beard
from the fallen Fenodyree.
You obtained the "@3rFenodyree's Beard@0r."
You honestly explained why you had come.
Ha ha ha ha ha!
So you need my beard to sew another protective charm?
Very well. You may have it. Here!
Fenodyree gave you the "@3rFenodyree's Beard@0r."
Fighting is not the only way, you know.
You had obtained every item @7rCyrus@0r requested.
It was time to take them back to @7rCyrus@0r at once.
You spotted a box fixed to the floor.
A small fairy sat before it, looking bored.
Something about the fairy reminded you of @7rLady Marbas@0r.
The Pretty
Good afternoon. Or is it good evening?
Oh, either will do.
I've been stuck here so long, I'm bored.
So very, very bored. And there's nothing to eat.
You've come at just the right time. Let me sip your soul.
You cut the wings from The Pretty's fallen body.
You obtained the "@3rThe Pretty's Wing@0r."
An old man stood before it with a furious expression.
Hylde Moer
It's because of you... This is all your fault!
Why must I be kept here,
all because of you people?!
After losing the battle, Hylde Moer
seemed to lose all trace of that furious expression
and collapsed on the spot, sobbing uncontrollably.
You obtained the "@3rHylde Moer's Tears@0r."
You spotted a box fixed to the floor. Beside it, an enormous rooster
with a snake's tail and gleaming scales glared at you.
It was a cockatrice!
From the fallen cockatrice,
you plucked several feathers.
You obtained the "@3rCockatrice Feather@0r."
Where is this stone tablet supposed to be, anyway?
@7rFiore@0r had begun to grumble.
Sure enough, nothing resembling a stone tablet was anywhere in sight.
Had it all been just a rumor after all?
A stone tablet... Hm? Aaaah!
There it is! Over there!
Where @7rFiore@0r pointed,
a golem with a trapezoidal tablet attached to its chest
was just awakening, its eyes beginning to glow.
The impact of the golem's fall
broke the tablet into three neat triangles.
Well, it broke.
Huh? There's something written where the tablet came off!
It says, "Into the triangular recess in the eastern wall,
fit one large triangle and three small triangles."
Besides these three triangles, is there a big one somewhere?
That was your only real clue.
For now, you should search the eastern wall for a triangular recess.
Huh? There's a big triangular hole here!
Just as @7rFiore@0r said, there was a large triangular recess.
But the recess was only about
as deep as the three triangular tablets were thick.
There were no other recesses for the small triangular tablets.
Each side of the triangular recess
was roughly twice the length of a side of the three triangles you held.
Faint, spindly letters were carved into the recess.
"Match the corners."
What could that mean?
Place one above and two below
Stack all three and push them in
Try biting a triangle
You placed one of the small triangles at the top,
then arranged the other two triangles beneath it.
Matching the tips of those two triangles
to the two bottom corners of the upper triangle
formed one large triangle with an inverted triangular hole in the middle.
